title: Belated Return u/s 139(4) & Mandatory Late Filing Fee under Section 234F
text: When a taxpayer misses the statutory due date under Section 139(1), a belated income tax return can still be filed under Section 139(4) up to December 31st of the relevant Assessment Year, or before completion of assessment, whichever is earlier. Filing belatedly under Section 139(4) attracts a mandatory late fee under Section 234F: Rs. 5,000 if total taxable income exceeds Rs. 5 Lakhs, or Rs. 1,000 if total income is up to Rs. 5 Lakhs. Taxpayers filing belated returns forfeit the valuable right to carry forward business losses and capital losses (speculative or non-speculative) to future assessment years, although loss from house property remains eligible for carry forward.
